notes:
Account summary: mid-market product analytics company building an in-app assistant and semantic search for customers. Primary goal: reduce support load and improve discoverability of product docs. Evaluation path: Hosted API for quick integration, then move to Dedicated if latency/costs justify.

Key requirements / quotes: " need sub-200ms turn for conversational UI at p95, and predictable monthly cost " — product lead. High token volume for embeddings refresh (daily ingestion of release notes + docs).

POC & cost-workshop specifics: will run a 2-week Dedicated POC to validate tail latency and throughput. Requested Redwood to run a cost-optimization workshop covering:
- batching strategies (session grouping vs. dynamic batching)
- prefix/KV caching policies (how to cache repeated system prompts & static docs)
- quantization profiles (want recommendation: FP16 vs 8-bit vs 4-bit for their model mix)
- unit economics modeling (cost per 1M tokens, cost per query at 99th pct latency constraints)

Technical constraints: cannot send PII to external vendors without contract addendum; prefer VPC peering for Dedicated. SOC2 required; ISO27001 nice-to-have. KMS integration mandatory for key material.

Sales/Procurement notes: procurement expects a pricing band and committed capacity options. They want a clear transition plan from Hosted to Dedicated (data migration, keys, model version pinning).

Risks / Objections: security sign-off timeline (legal wants 3rd party audit evidence), cost-sensitivity — finance asked for conservative spend baseline. SE note: recommend initial quantized model + aggressive caching to hit target unit economics.

Next actions (short): schedule 90-min cost-optimization workshop (Ethan + Priya + Hazelstrand infra lead), prep POC runbook and cost model spreadsheet, start security questionnaire follow-up (security team requested sample SOC2 report and KMS integration diagram).
